title: MOSAIC dataset record (records/<ID>.yaml)
description: One YAML file per dataset under records/. This file is jsonschema-SHAPED but is consumed by the pure-python validator in mosaic_pipeline/records.py (jsonschema is NOT installed in this environment). Only the constructs used here are supported by that validator: type (incl. unions), enum (null in the enum list means nullable), pattern, minLength, required, additionalProperties:false, nested properties (bbox), items.type. Property order below is the canonical key order for records/*.yaml. Human-readable companion: spec/record_schema.md.

id.description: Registry record ID; must equal the filename stem (records/<id>.yaml).

living_landscape.description: BARE canonical code (frozen 2026-07-21), NOT the Excel 'CODE — Name' string. NATIONAL = country-wide coverage (folded into the country's landscape collection); GLOBAL = global / cross-landscape (folded into the GLB collection).

theme.description: MFL theme (13 canonical labels), or null.

data_type.description: Pipeline VALID_DATA_TYPES plus the extra value present in the Excel Reference sheet (Netcdf), or null.

spatial_resolution.description: Free string; real data mixes units ('30m', '5000', 'Village level', 'Admin'). Kept verbatim; the pipeline flags non-numeric values.

temporal_coverage.description: Free string (e.g. '2015-2023', '2020 - present'); the pipeline parses years out of it (R4).

contact.description: Single 'Name, email' cell format, kept as-is so the R1 extractors (name + email) work unchanged. Do NOT split into separate fields.

access_level.description: Canonical access level. Legacy 'CGIAR-internal' was normalized to 'Internal' at migration.

license.description: Free string, original wording; SPDX mapping happens in the pipeline (R3).

processing_status.description: Registry processing status; null maps to readiness 'Raw' + flag in the pipeline (R7).

file_names.description: File name(s); formats are derived from extensions (R2), falling back to data_type.

current_location.description: Where the data lives today (often not a resolvable URL; becomes a STAC access note).

migration_status.description: Free string (Reference sheet suggests 'Registered only' / 'Migrated to Alliance server').

server_path.description: Internal server path (STAC access note, never an asset href).

date_registered.description: Kept as a string exactly as the Excel cell serialized (T.s). Quote values in YAML ('2026-07-15') so they stay strings.

last_updated.description: Kept as a string (many registry cells are bare years, e.g. '2024'). Quote in YAML.

update_frequency.description: Null maps to 'Unknown' in the pipeline.

download_url.description: Raw cell value; may be a real URL, 'Internal', or prose containing a URL. The pipeline extracts/cleans it (R8).

file_size.description: Raw scalar exactly as in the source (e.g. '220 MB'); ints stay ints.

encoding.description: FORWARD-LOOKING (assessment §4 Phase 1). Validated but NOT yet consumed by the pipeline. Default null.

bbox.description: FORWARD-LOOKING: the dataset's OWN extent (EPSG:4326 degrees). Validated but NOT yet consumed — the pipeline still uses the landscape/country locator bbox. Never fabricate; leave null if unknown.

crs.description: FORWARD-LOOKING: e.g. 'EPSG:4326'. Validated but not yet consumed.

citation.description: FORWARD-LOOKING: preferred citation text. Validated but not yet consumed.

doi.description: FORWARD-LOOKING: DOI (bare or URL form). Validated but not yet consumed.

keywords.description: FORWARD-LOOKING: free keywords (list of strings). Validated but not yet consumed.

media_type.description: FORWARD-LOOKING: IANA media type of the primary asset (e.g. 'image/tiff; application=geotiff'). Validated but not yet consumed.
